meta.rule: Statutory exposure is not a personal assessment. Personal penalty amounts are blank.

rows.conduct: Splitting or deceptive outward transfer to evade FX controls
rows.statutory_scale: Art. 39: order repatriation; fine up to 30% of the evaded amount; serious cases 30% up to the equivalent amount; criminal liability where constituted.

rows.conduct: Private, disguised or illegal introduction of FX dealing
rows.statutory_scale: Art. 45: warning, confiscation of illegal gains, fine of 30% or more of the illegal amount; serious cases 30% up to the equivalent amount; criminal liability where constituted.
2026 No.42 provides punishment under relevant rules and criminal referral where constituted; no personal numeric rate is populated.
Reporting thresholds are sourced; current inflation-adjusted penalty amounts are not verified here and remain blank.
